en.title: The Lighthouse Light and the Silver Salt of Days Gone By
en.premise: After taking over the photography studio left behind by her grandfather Genzō, she discovers the epilogues of lovers who vanished beyond the border, along with a new letter. Together with Saeki, the secondhand bookstore owner, she sets out on a journey connecting past memories and the present, aiming this time for another "Hill of Promise" hidden within the town. Old photographs and sepia-toned memories cast a new light amidst lost time.

zh.title: 灯塔的光芒与往日的银盐
zh.premise: 继承了祖父源造留下的照相馆后，我发现了消失在边界那头的情侣们的后日谈，以及一封崭新的信件。我和旧书店老板佐伯一起，这一次将目标对准了镇上隐藏的另一个“约定之丘”，踏上了连接过去记忆与现在的旅程。泛黄的照片与褪色的回忆，在失落的时光中点亮了新的光芒。
